title: Line Cook
text: The dinner rush is your whole personality.

title: Bike Courier
text: Rain just means the city is paying you extra.

title: Record Clerk
text: You know where everything is, including the gossip.

title: Shift Lead
text: You unlock the shop and lock it again.

title: Studio Hand
text: Cables, coffee, and the occasional credit.

title: Route Driver
text: Same streets, better stories every week.

title: Floor Nurse
text: Nights are long and the shoes are older.

title: Site Lead
text: Hard hats, clipboards, and a radio that never sleeps.

title: Shop Mechanic
text: If it rattles, it ends up in your bay.

title: Cabin Crew
text: You live out of a neatly packed carry-on.

title: Retail Buyer
text: You can tell what will sell by the weight of it.
